content: Yesu lak kaday tharaydhin igililnga
Thanamun sabathoenu kalanu, Mariya Magdaloengu a wara na Mariya, palay moerampa uzarmoedhin mina bathaynga.
Palay nanga amadhan aymoeman, kedha nanga boeradhar garguy mizin, Awgadhaw angela mulupa pagan daparngu, kula adhapa thaman, sin gimal thanuriz.
Nuy poenipoenidh koey buyalnga a nungu rugal adhapudhay koey goerab gamulmayl.

Thanamun koewbu mabaygaw aka mina koeyza, gamul koeyma galupamoeyn akan; kalanu thana ngoedhe uma gamul midh nanga. Nuy Angela yoepkazipa muliz kedha, ‘Koeyma wakay thoemamayg, ngay ngulayg kedha, ngipel Yesun lumaypa, ngan nanga sathawrawnu puydhayngu, kasa kay kedha nuy in lawnga. Nuyn kadaypa maninu umangu, nuy kulay midh nanga umepu. Ayawal imaw, nuyn ngalaga nanga wananu.

Ngipel kazaginga uzarmoeriw nungu niyaykazipa yadu thuraypa kedha, “Nuyn kaday tharayngu umangu nubi thonara, nuy Galilayapa bangal ngithamuniya kulay. Ngitha nanga Galilayoenu mangemine, ngitha bangal nuyn imane.” Nuy lak muliz kedha palamulpa, “Ngaw ya ngipelngu yakanurayg.” ’
Palay balbayginga moeramoengu kuniya tideman, palamun kedha aka a dhiw muynu. Palay kaday thareman nungu niyaykazipa yadu thuraypa.
Kedha nanga Yesu dhadha mangiz palamuniya, nuy kedha muliz, ‘Woenab ngipeniya kalmel.’ Palay nanga karngemin palay lak nungu siyara apapudheman a lak thawmanin nuyn.
Nuy kedha, ‘Ngipel akag, uzarmoeriw ngaw tukuypoepa mulemoeriw kedha, “Galilayapa bangal ladhune.” Thana bangal ngoena sin imane.’
Koewbu mabaygan kuyku misnarepa yadupalgadhin
Palay nanga sepalbi yoepkaz uzarmoedhin, dhuray koewbu mabaygal, moeram ngaya nanga danal poethar, kuniya ladhudhin, kuyku misnarel ngulayg palaydhin kedha, mura zapul midh nanga.

Kalanu thana kuyku misnarel a dhuray koey mabaygal garwoeydhamoeydhin a buwayl thayadhin kedha koewbu mabaygoepa, ‘Ngitha bangal mura mabaygoepa yadu palgane kedha, “Kubilu ngoey uthun idimar. Wa, senawbi thonara Yesun niyaykazin nungu gamu madhin.” Ngitha nanga kedha ya oengane, wa ngoey ngithamulpa kay bokadhzapun poeybane.’
Thana lak koewbu mabaygoepa mulemidhin kedha, ‘Ngithamun kuyku mabayg nanga ngulayg asine ngithamun yangukudungu, ngoey bangal nuyn yadu palgane, nungungu gegeyadh gasamoeyle.’

Thana danal poethayzi koewbu mabaygal kusumadhin sethabi bokadhzapul a mura mabaygoepa yadu palgamoeydhin setha mi yangukudul nanga thana Yoewdhayalgaw koey mabaygal thanamulpa mulemidhin. Kalanu senabi yangukudu kasa yadu palgadhin mura Yoewdhayalgiya. Soeyzi ngapa kurusipa kayib thanamun ngulayg kedha, Yesun niyaykazin nungu gamu purunu wardhadhin moeramoengu.
Yesu yakamaydhin nungu niyaykazipa
Kalanu leben niyaykazil ladhudhin Galilayapa, thanamulpa kulay seysithamadhin thanamulpa garwoeydhamaypa.
Thana nanga nuyn imadhin dhuray thana koesar wakay thamamayil gasamoedhin. Thana koerawaygal kedha, in mina nuy lawnga midh; kasa kedha thana mura nuyn thawmadhin.
Nuy amadhan thamaydhin, thanamulpa kedha mulaydhin, ‘In ngayapa poeybangu, mura kupayl daparaw, a matha kedha nubi apaw goewaw.

Ngitha bangal mura nubi apaw goewaw mabaygal ngurpamoeypu, ngithamun mab nanga mura wadhwadhgamuya a thana bangal ngaw niyaykazil aymoeypu. Ngitha bangal thanamuniya papthayso maypa a thana kalanu Awgadhaw buwaypa sakariya thayamoeyne.

Ngitha kedha zageth oengaw; ngurpamoeypu bangal thana, ngaw ngurpan ngath ngitha midh zapun nanga ngurpamaydhin. Thana mura kedha ngurpay oengaypa. Ngitha bangal koeyma ngoenanu mayparuy kedha, ngay bangal ngithamuniya kalmel, kurusipa bangal nubi gugu ubidh thoeyayzimayngu kuth.’
